SELECT DATE_FORMAT(warning_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM swm_warning_management WHERE DATE(warning_time) BETWEEN #{beginDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND status = '0' AND (CASE WHEN #{isHazardSourceAlarm,jdbcType=BOOLEAN} = TRUE THEN warning_content = '鍗遍櫓婧愭姤璀? ELSE warning_content != '鍗遍櫓婧愭姤璀? END) GROUP BY DATE(warning_time) ORDER BY date

AND warning_content != '涓€閿甋OS' AND warning_content != '鑰冨嫟鎵撳崱' AND warning_content != '杩涘叆澶ч棬' GROUP BY warning_content ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

GROUP BY a.person_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.person_name AS personName, a.warning_type AS warningType, a.warning_content AS warningContent, a.warning_time AS warningTime, a.alarm_record AS alarmRecord, a.alarm_time AS alarmTime, a.trigger_reason AS triggerReason, a.handler, a.handle_time AS handleTime, a.handle_process AS handleProcess, a.handle_status AS handleStatus, a.attachment, a.device_id AS deviceId, a.id_card AS idCard, a.hazard_category AS hazardCategory FROM swm_warning_management a WHERE a.status = '0' AND (CASE WHEN #{isHazardSourceAlarm,jdbcType=BOOLEAN} = TRUE THEN warning_content = '鍗遍櫓婧愭姤璀? ELSE warning_content != '鍗遍櫓婧愭姤璀? END) order by a.warning_time desc limit #{limit}

SELECT a.handler AS "handler", ROUND(AVG(a.disposal_duration), 2) AS "avgHandleMinutes" FROM swm_warning_management a WHERE a.warning_content != '鍗遍櫓婧愭姤璀? AND a.handle_status = '1' AND a.handler IS NOT NULL AND a.disposal_duration IS NOT NULL AND DATE(handle_time) BETWEEN #{beginDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY a.handler HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY avgHandleMinutes ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM swm_warning_management a WHERE a.handle_status = '1' AND DATE(handle_time) BETWEEN #{beginDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND a.status = '0'
